items.hook: The State Security Service, also known by its original name as the Directorate for State Security, was the national secret police intelligence and security agency of Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia.
items.body: It was at all times best known by the acronym UDBA, which is derived from the organization's original name in the Serbo-Croatian language: "Uprava državne bezbednosti". The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: Meaningful broadband is an ethics-driven framework for closing the digital divide in Asia.
items.body: It has been adopted by Indonesia and Thailand, and it has influenced other Asian nations. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: The Emergency Broadcast System (EBS), sometimes called the Emergency Action Notification System (EANS), was an emergency warning system used in the United States.
items.body: It was the most commonly used, along with the Emergency Override system. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: The show jumping horse killings scandal refers to an unverified number of insurance fraud cases in the United States between the mid-1970s and the mid-1990s in which expensive horses, many of them show jumpers, were insured against death, accident, or disease, and then killed to collect the insurance money.
items.body: Many of the killings involved racketeering, and numerous perpetrators were convicted of crimes. The world is stranger than it lets on.
